headlines: US Moves Toward Renewed Major Combat Operations Against Iran as Tehran Escalates in the Gulf
Houthi Strikes on Saudi Airports Widen the Yemen War as Riyadh Courts Syrian Troops
Russia Follows Mass Missile Barrage With Kramatorsk Bus Strike; Kyiv Hits a Yandex Data Center
Europe Hardens Against Russia's Sabotage Campaign as Washington Explores a Nord Stream Deal
Seoul Recalls Its Ambassador From Kyiv and Flies Its First Hypersonic Weapon
Eritrean Forces Enter Tigray, Pushing Ethiopia and Eritrea Toward Direct War
WHO Still Lacks Answers on Russia's Plague-Lab Death as Moscow Closes the Case
editions.summary: We assess Washington is closer to resuming major strikes on Iran than at any point since April, with CENTCOM told to finish preparations and Tehran escalating tanker attacks in the Gulf; the Houthi campaign has widened to Saudi airports, Russia followed a mass barrage with a Kramatorsk bus strike that killed 33, and Eritrean forces have entered Tigray.
